title.en: The Chinese sources and the Theory of Becoming

scope.en: The relational ontology of Chinese thought read against the Theory of Becoming: the 易 and 易传, the 道家, the 儒家, the script (止戈为武 among it) and other lines, mapped passage by passage onto the formal spine and integrated where the map finds a law the spine lacks. Requested by Ren on 19 October 2026 and shown in the README at his request the same day. The thesis that these lines continue one relational ontology is tested, not assumed. Extended on 21 October 2026, at his request of 19 October, to every complete judgment of 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 and to a 中华 edition of the theory written in classical names. Extended on 22 October 2026, at his request of that day, to 文理生生 (a classical-Chinese concept grammar built apart from the 中华本), with the epistemology of 文 at the centre and 文 named the course.
scope.zh: 以生成之论读中国思想的关系本体：易与易传、道家、儒家、文字（其中有止戈为武）及其他各线，逐段对应到形式脊柱上，并在对应发现脊柱所缺之律处加以整合。Ren 于2026年10月19日提出，同日要求列入 README。诸线延续同一种关系本体之说是要检验的论题，不是前提。2026年10月21日，按 Ren 10月19日的要求，扩展到《中华思想脉络》v1.0 的全部完整判断，以及以古典之名写成的理论中华本。2026年10月22日应其当日之要求，扩展到文理生生（与中华本分开所建之古汉语概念文法），以文之认识论为中心，以文名一历逐步之值。

objective.en: Tie each passage, quoted verbatim from a preserved text, to checked declarations and records as agreement, exact scope or divergence; state where each tradition's universal forms need a scope and where it diverges; prove in the pure core the laws the passages point at and the spine lacks, or show them false.
objective.zh: 把每一段（从所存文本逐字引出）以相合、定域或相分对应到已检查的声明与记录；写明各传统的全称形式何处需要定域、何处相分；在纯核心中证明诸段所指而脊柱所缺之律，或说明其不成立。

premises.en: Begin with one relational unfolding. A passage counts as relational when it reads the relation first and lets the terms differentiate within it, not from a prior ground, a nature or value fixed before relations, a will or single centre, or a contest or rank. The readings are the AI's (decision D54) and keep their labels; agreement means the spine has a law of that structure, not that the text's authors meant it.
premises.zh: 从一个关系的展开开始。一段文字先读关系、让诸项在其中分化，而不是出自先在的根据、先于关系而定的性或价值、意志或单一中心、争胜或等级，才算关系的。读法是 AI 的（决定 D54），保留其标注；相合是说脊柱上有结构相同之律，不是说原文作者意谓此律。

completion.en: The passage map verifies (verify_ro.py) and every gap it lists is proved in the pure core, shown false, or kept open with its statement. Completing the map does not show that one relational ontology is the doctrine of every line, or that agreement confirms either side.
completion.zh: 对应表通过检查（verify_ro.py），所列每项缺口或在纯核心中证明，或说明其不成立，或连同其陈述保留为开放。完成对应不说明一种关系本体是每一家的学说，也不说明相合证实了任何一方。

title.en: Mapping the relational thread in Chinese thought onto the spine
title.zh: 中国思想中的关系之线，逐段对应到脊柱

summary.en: 248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought (the 易传, the 老子 with its commentaries and excavated witnesses, the 儒家, the script with 止戈为武, 庄子 and 玄学, 墨辩 and 名家, 兵家 and 法家, Buddhist lines) are quoted verbatim from hash-bound texts and tied to checked laws of the spine: 91 agree, 98 hold within an exact scope, 59 diverge. Agreement means the spine has a law of the same structure, often only under premises the reading states, not that a passage is true as it says or that its authors meant the law. The relational start holds in every line and is a leading thread, not a property of every system; their universal forms mostly need a scope; four non-relational overlays (a prior ground, a fixed nature, a single centre, contest and rank) recur, each answered inside its own tradition. The script is relational as a system of readings, not in the shapes of its graphs. Most gaps the map found are proved in the core: the arrangements of the 傳 (`Becoming.HexagramSequences`), a code formed between formations (约定俗成, `Becoming.SharedCodes`), capture through the rule (二柄, 据有余而制不足; `Becoming.RuleCapture`) and two-sided regulation of a level and regulation that reads the level late (中和, 宽猛相济; `Becoming.Regulation`) have landed, and the four earlier Chinese chapters (in history since 23 October 2026) keep only what the map and the spine do not carry. The map was then extended to every one of the 5,673 complete judgments of 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 (庄, 墨, 名辩, 兵 and 法 with 儒, 道, 佛 and the 易): 3,514 bear on a structure of the theory and each lies in one place in the cluster it was flagged for, in 1,300 checked entries; agreements and exact scopes are 81% of the judgments mapped, divergences 19%, 13% in pre-Qin texts. From those texts and the drafting 449 classical names were fixed, one per concept, 242 of the 248 quoted names witnessed before 秦, and the theory as it stood on 22 October 2026 (the book dated 21 October) was stated in them in the 中华本《变化论》, with 經, 說 and 證 for each law (in history since 23 October 2026, its laws now stated by the eight chapters, its 經 and each 篇's closing correspondences with the classical texts only in it). 文理生生, a classical-Chinese concept grammar built apart from the 中华本, was then compared with it: 88 of the 117 characters both judge agree (independence partial: the same corpus, both AI-written). 文 was named the course, a run's states read through a map step by step (`Becoming.Parting.course`), and the epistemology of 文 was tied link by link to checked laws, each with its scope (a correspondence, not a confirmation; whether classical Chinese is the best expression is untested).
summary.zh: 中国思想九个部分的 248 段文字（易传、老子及其注与出土诸本、儒家、文字与止戈为武、庄子与玄学、墨辩与名家、兵家与法家、汉传佛教各线）从以哈希绑定的文本逐字引出，对应到脊柱上已检查之律：相合 91 段，定域 98 段，相分 59 段。相合是说脊柱有一条结构相同的律（常常只在读法所写明的前提下），不是说原文如其所说为真，或其作者意谓此律。关系的起点在诸线中都成立，是一条主导线索，不是每一体系的性质；其全称形式大多需要定域；四种非关系之层（先在的根据、固定的性、单一中心、争胜与等级）反复出现，各在本传统内部得到回应。文字作为读法系统是关系的，而不在字形。对应所发现的缺口，多已在核心中证明：传之排列（`Becoming.HexagramSequences`），在形成之间形成的编码、约定俗成（`Becoming.SharedCodes`），经由规则的捕获（二柄、据有余而制不足；`Becoming.RuleCapture`），以及水平的双向调节与迟到读法下的调节（中和、宽猛相济；`Becoming.Regulation`）已落地，较早的四个中国章节（10月23日移入 history/）只保留对应与脊柱所不承载者。其后对应扩展到《中华思想脉络》v1.0 的全部 5,673 条完整判断（庄、墨、名辩、兵、法，以及儒、道、佛与易）：3,514 条关乎理论的某一结构，各在所标之簇恰落一处，归为 1,300 个已检查条目；已对应的判断中相合与定域占 81%，相分 19%，先秦文本中 13%。由这些文字与起草定出 449 个古典之名，每个概念一个，录有引文的 248 个中 242 个见于先秦文本；理论以这些名写成中华本《变化论》（书首署2026年10月21日，22日仍有修订；10月23日移入 history/，其律今由八章陈述，經与每篇之末的对照只见于此本），每条律有經、說、證。其后与文理生生（与中华本分开所建之古汉语概念文法）对照：两边皆判之 117 字中 88 字相合（独立只是部分的：同一语料，都由 AI 写成）。以文名一历之状经一象逐步之值（`Becoming.Parting.course`），文之认识论逐环对到已检之律，各写其域（对应不是印证；古汉语是否最好之表达未经检验）。

next_step.en: Review by people, the line's last step: the classifications, mappings, readings, names and the choices made in the censuses are all AI's, and no person's review of them is recorded. Two gaps stay open: the Hall-type existence condition for division across several conditions (分), of which a sufficient condition is proved, and a law grading by the least closure level from a centre, with whether that order is the same from every standpoint (亲亲之杀; the full reading of 《中华思想脉络》 marks it a note of scope, and there is no law yet). Tolerance compared across laws (柔弱者生之徒) is proved on both sides proposed (showing only that more tolerance gives no less, not that it is better), and every gap the full reading named is answered by a law or marked a note of scope. Also open, among others in chapter 6's Open: whether the readings agree with what the texts meant in their time; the 181 later candidates, untested; what change 穷 → 变 → 通 speaks of; and whether the corpus gives pairing and power.
next_step.zh: 人审是这条线的最后一步：归类、对应、读法、名与普查之选都是 AI 所为，尚无人审之记录。两项缺口仍开：跨多个条件之“分”的霍尔型存在条件（一个充分条件已证），以及从中心按最小闭包层级分等之律及此序是否对每一立场相同（亲亲之杀；《脉络》之对应标为范围之注，尚无律）。跨律比较容忍（柔弱者生之徒）所拟两面皆已证（只表明容忍较多者给予不少，不表明它更好）；全读所提之缺口，或得其律，或标为范围之注。另有未决（第六章未决中尚有他项）：读法是否合于史义；后加的 181 条乙类候选尚未检验；“穷 → 变 → 通”所言何变；语料是否给出配对与幂。
